The [Living Lab Explorer](https://iat-dml.github.io/living-lab-explorer/) is a work-in-progress project building upon factsheets prepared by the IAT Regional Network Managers to create interactive dashboards to allow practice partners and researchers to gain an understanding of the environmental and socio-economic conditions that characterise the five IAT Living Labs.
